relations.subject: Friedrich Rückert
relations.evidence: studies of law, languages and literature at Würzburg (1805-09)

relations.subject: Friedrich Rückert
relations.evidence: and Jena (1810-12), without too much interest. ... Ph.D. 1811 Jena.

relations.subject: Friedrich Rückert
relations.evidence: Returning from Italy he met von Hammer-Purgstall in Vienna and now became interested in Oriental studies, in 1818-19 studied at Vienna Islamic languages under him.

relations.subject: Friedrich Rückert
relations.evidence: In 1826-41 Professor of Oriental Languages at Erlangen (teaching also Sanskrit)

relations.subject: Friedrich Rückert
relations.evidence: Professor in Erlangen and Berlin. ... in 1841-49 at Berlin.

relations.subject: Max Müller
relations.evidence: In Berlin he did not thrive well and had very few students (yet Max Müller).

relations.subject: Spiegel
relations.evidence: As a teacher he also taught Avesta and had Spiegel among his students (also in Sanskrit).
